title: P1 Stability Fixes
objective: Menyelesaikan regresi workflow, migration, sync, recovery, accessibility, dan compatibility dengan perubahan minimum.
limits: Register lokal dependency-free; register kosong tetap BLOCKED tanpa klaim regresi nyata. Tidak membuktikan incident produksi, telemetry, native GUI, hosted CI, credential, signing public-trust, hardware, atau publikasi; gate eksternal DEFERRED-EXTERNAL.
